<a id="toc-benchmarks"></a>
## 2. Official Liquid AI Benchmarks

LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B parameter reasoning model with only 2B active parameters per token, outperforming larger dense and sparse alternatives across agentic, coding, and mathematical evaluations while running up to 1.7x faster on edge devices:

![LFM2.5-24B-A2B Benchmarks](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B/resolve/main/figures/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-benchmark.png)

### Key Empirical Strengths:
- **Autonomous Tool-Use & Function Calling:** Reaches state-of-the-art results on LiveClaw (48.09 vs 38.19 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) and BFCL v4.
- **Constant Latency Linear ConvNet Backbone:** 30 of the 40 layers utilize 1D short convolutions with O(1) state caching, resulting in blistering inference speeds and near-zero TTFT overhead.
- **Periodic Attention Anchor:** 10 full attention layers distributed every 4 blocks retain long-horizon coherence up to 128,000 tokens.

![Edge and GPU Inference Speed](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B/resolve/main/figures/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-edge-inference.png)

<a id="toc-tensormap"></a>
## 3. Empirically Audited Tensor Precision Map

Empirical binary audit of all 428 tensors stored within `LFM2.5-24B-A2B.APEX-I-NanoPlus.gguf`:

```
========================================================================================
AUDITED GGUF TENSOR ARCHITECTURE (TOTAL STORED TENSORS: 428)
========================================================================================
Format      Count    Share %    Target Components & Architectural Allocation
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
F32           207     48.36%    Zero-drift Routers (ffn_gate_inp), Norms, Biases, Conv Kernels
Q4_K           97     22.66%    Dense FFN Lead-In (0-1), Attention q/k/v, Shortconv, Embeddings
IQ3_XXS        42      9.81%    Border Experts (gate/up: Layers 2,3,38,39) & Core Experts (down: Layers 4-37)
IQ2_S          34      7.94%    Core MoE Experts (gate: Layers 4 to 37)
IQ2_XXS        34      7.94%    Core MoE Experts (up: Layers 4 to 37)
Q6_K           10      2.34%    Attention Output Heads (All 10 Full Attention Layers)
Q3_K            4      0.93%    Border MoE Experts (down: Layers 2, 3, 38, 39)
========================================================================================
```

### Detailed Layer Breakdown:

| Layer Range | Block Architecture | Component / Tensor Target | Quantization Format | Design Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Global** | Vocab & Output | `token_embd.weight` (Tied output) | **`Q4_K`** | Preserves core lexical and tokenization fidelity |
| **Global** | Embedding Norm | `token_embd_norm.weight` | **`F32`** | Exact normalizer preservation |
| **Layers 0 & 1** | Dense FFN Lead-In | `blk.{0,1}.ffn_{gate,down,up}.weight` | **`Q4_K`** | Uncompressed 4-bit protection on initial representation blocks |
| **Layers 0 to 39** | MoE Routing Gates | `blk.{2..39}.ffn_gate_inp.weight` | **`F32`** | Absolute zero routing drift across all 64 experts |
| **Layers 0 to 39** | Layer Normalizers | `blk.*.{attn_norm,ffn_norm}` | **`F32`** | Unquantized layer normalizers |
| **Layers 2..39** | Expert Biases | `blk.*.exp_probs_b.bias` | **`F32`** | Exact expert logit bias preservation |
| **10 Layers** (2,6,10,14,18,22,26,30,34,38) | Quadratic Attention | `blk.*.attn_{q,k,v}.weight` | **`Q4_K`** | Robust multi-head projection fidelity up to 128K context |
| **10 Layers** (2,6,10,14,18,22,26,30,34,38) | Attention Projection | `blk.*.attn_output.weight` | **`Q6_K`** | Protected output projections for long-horizon attention |
| **30 Layers** (Linear Conv) | Shortconv 1D | `blk.*.shortconv.{in,out}_proj.weight` | **`Q4_K`** | High-speed linear projection across all 30 non-quadratic blocks |
| **30 Layers** (Linear Conv) | Conv Kernels | `blk.*.shortconv.conv.weight` | **`F32`** | Precision retention for 1D convolution weights |
| **Layers 2, 3, 38, 39** (4 Layers) | Border MoE Down | `blk.*.ffn_down_exps.weight` | **`Q3_K`** | High stability for critical down-projections at boundary layers |
| **Layers 2, 3, 38, 39** (4 Layers) | Border MoE Gate/Up | `blk.*.ffn_{gate,up}_exps.weight` | **`IQ3_XXS`** | Balanced importance quantization at ingress and egress |
| **Layers 4–37** (34 Layers) | Core MoE Down | `blk.*.ffn_down_exps.weight` | **`IQ3_XXS`** | Protected projection matrix for intermediate reasoning tokens |
| **Layers 4–37** (34 Layers) | Core MoE Gate | `blk.*.ffn_gate_exps.weight` | **`IQ2_S`** | Calibrated 2-bit grid quantization for expert gating |
| **Layers 4–37** (34 Layers) | Core MoE Up | `blk.*.ffn_up_exps.weight` | **`IQ2_XXS`** | Lightweight up-projection for maximum memory throughput |

<a id="toc-08"></a>
## 5. Recommended Generation Parameters

Official recommended generation hyperparameters as specified in `generation_config.json` by Liquid AI:

| Parameter | Recommended Value | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Temperature** | `0.1` | Low temperature ensures sharp, factual, and reproducible reasoning trajectories. |
| **Top-K** | `50` | Filters candidate tokens to the top 50 logit distribution. |
| **Top-P** | `0.95` | Standard nucleus threshold for balanced exploration. |
| **Repetition Penalty** | `1.05` | Mild penalty preventing looping without distorting coding indentation. |
| **Max Context** | `131,072` | Native context capacity (`128K`). |

<a id="toc-07"></a>
## 6. Serving & Deployment Setup

### llama.cpp Server (OpenAI-Compatible Endpoint)

```bash
llama-server   -m LFM2.5-24B-A2B.APEX-I-NanoPlus.gguf   -c 32768   -ngl 99   --port 8080   --temp 0.1   --top-k 50   --repeat-penalty 1.05
```

### ChatML Prompt Template Structure

```markdown
<|startoftext|><|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant trained by Liquid AI.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
Write a high-performance Python script to parse large JSON streams.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>
```
